title: Kestrel and the Monsoon
author: Isandro Kavanagh
blurb: Ivo Crane, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must cross the range ahead of the snows before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
